newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF HAMMER WORLD CHAMPION WEIS.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF HAMMER WORLD CHAMPION WEIS.

text.p: Profile of Heinz Weis, who won the world hammer title on Sunday.
A 34-year-old veteran who was still chasing his first major title. His best result at previous world championships had been third place in 1991.
Consistently among the world's best throwers, he won the World Cup after an excellent season in 1989.
Warmed up for the world championships by beating his personal best with a throw of 83.04 metres and said before the competition that he was in the best form of his career.
